scope: Compare app npm test ownership and reachability in Product main and development before selective promotion.

developmentWorkflowSnapshot.note: PR #438 changed only documentation; workflow definitions remain byte-identical to the inspected development ref.

evidence.source: Product PR #436 exact-head validation and integration
evidence.detail: On development, the duplicated app npm test step was removed only from candidate-assets and variant-fidelity. Their specialized assertions remain, and app-build-purity retains npm test for app/** changes. The #436 PR-head asset, variant, and impact-plan runs passed.
Main still runs npm test in all three workflows for the overlapping app/** pull-request paths; the same suite remains protected by app-build-purity if the two specialized invocations are removed.

recommendation: Prepare a selective main PR that removes only the npm test step from candidate-assets.yml and variant-fidelity.yml. Keep the full npm test in app-build-purity.yml and keep every specialized asset, mask, render, and variant check.
limits: This is workflow-source equivalence and reachability evidence, not a live run result.
The exact PR checks for the proposed main workflow change have not run yet.
This does not establish equivalence for any other repeated assertions.
